work.text: build and maintain internal MERN-stack tools, including an HRMS and a gate-pass system
set up centralized logging and monitoring on the Elastic Stack (Elasticsearch, Logstash, Kibana, Filebeat)
add Elastic APM with Fleet-managed agents to trace Java microservices
write Logstash pipelines with Grok patterns for CSV, JSON and free-form logs
build semantic search with BERT embeddings over datasets of 100M+ records
automate builds and AWS deploys with Dockerfiles and GitHub Actions
build the backend of a devotional app: daily prayer logs, scored checklists, levels and guides, with phone and Google sign-in
build its React admin panel for content, checklists, levels, languages and time zones
integrate Shipway into an online bookshop: shipments created after verified payment, carrier rates, pincode checks and order tracking
build checkout, order history and a banner manager across the storefront and its dashboard
deploy on AWS behind Nginx, with Cloudinary for media and Cloudflare rate limiting
lead the team building a self-hosted office suite: documents, drive, meetings, sheets and slides behind one sign-in
build the collaboration service for the spreadsheet: Keycloak sign-in, and sockets for presence, cursors and permission-checked edits
build a visual workflow builder on ReactFlow with 32 node types, including HTTP, code, LLM and machine-learning nodes
build a slide editor with 50-step undo, a slideshow mode and PowerPoint export
build a drag-and-drop page builder with 32 components that generates React code
deploy the suite with Docker Compose: PostgreSQL, Redis and Keycloak over HTTPS, behind a reverse proxy
build an eight-phase agent pipeline that reads vendor email, finds the approval record and proposes the update
give the agent 43 read-only MCP tools, scoped per phase; every write waits for a person
carry work on Redis Streams with a transactional outbox, retries, dead letters and per-phase checkpoints
build Gmail, Microsoft 365 and IMAP ingestion with OAuth2 and AES-256-GCM storage
replay real cases nightly, gate prompts and tools in CI, trace every run with Langfuse
ship SAP Business One analytics: custom Airbyte connector, 36 dbt models, 5 Superset dashboards, cash-flow forecast
find reviewer markups on PDF drawings with YOLO and OCR, then check the next revision with GPT-4o
